```{python}
# import libraries
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns
import itables
import dayplot
import plotly_express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import pypalettes
from plotly_calheatmap import calheatmap
from shiny.express import render, ui
```

```{python}
# load data
items = pd.read_csv('bakery_sales_dataset/bakery_sales_revised.csv')

# create detailed date columns
items['date_time'] = items['date_time'].apply(pd.Timestamp)
items['date'] = items['date_time'].dt.date
items['time'] = items['date_time'].dt.time
items['year'] = items['date_time'].dt.year
items['month'] = items['date_time'].dt.month
items['year_month'] = items['date_time'].map(lambda x: str(x.year) + '-' + str(x.month))
items['day_of_week'] = items['date_time'].dt.dayofweek
items['day_name'] = items['date_time'].dt.day_name()
items['hour'] = items['date_time'].dt.hour
items['week_number'] = items['date_time'].dt.isocalendar().week
items['year_week'] = items['year'].astype(str) + '-' + items['week_number'].astype(str)
```

```{python}
# Calculated columns

# totals by month
items_sold_by_month = items[['year_month', 'Transaction']].groupby('year_month', as_index=False).count()
transactions_by_month = items[['year_month', 'Transaction']].groupby('year_month', as_index=False).nunique()

# by day
items_sold_by_day = items[['date', 'Transaction']].groupby(['date']).count()
transactions_by_day = items[['date', 'Transaction']].groupby(['date']).nunique()

# by day of week
items_sold_by_day_of_week = items[['week_number', 'day_name', 'Transaction']].groupby(['week_number', 'day_name']).count().reset_index()
transactions_by_day_of_week = items[['week_number', 'day_name', 'Transaction']].groupby(['week_number', 'day_name']).nunique().reset_index()

# weekday vs weekend
items_sold_weekday_weekend = items[['week_number', 'weekday_weekend', 'Transaction']].groupby(['week_number', 'weekday_weekend']).count()
transactions_weekday_weekendy = items[['week_number', 'weekday_weekend', 'Transaction']].groupby(['week_number', 'weekday_weekend']).nunique()

# totals by hour
items_sold_by_hour = items[['day_name', 'hour', 'Transaction']].groupby(['day_name', 'hour']).count().reset_index()
transactions_by_hour = items[['day_name', 'hour', 'Transaction']].groupby(['day_name', 'hour']).nunique().reset_index()

# group by transaction
items_by_transaction = items[['Transaction', 'Item']].groupby('Transaction').agg(lambda x: list(x))
other = items.drop(columns='Item').drop_duplicates().set_index('Transaction')
items_by_transaction = items_by_transaction.join(other, on='Transaction').reset_index()
```

```{python}
# Calculated values

# Total items sold
total_items_sold = len(items)

# Total transactions
total_transactions = len(items['Transaction'].unique())

# mean number of items per transaction
items_per_transaction = items_by_transaction['Item'].apply(len).mean()
```

```{python}
# Define colors and fonts
cmap = pypalettes.load_cmap('sPBIGn')
colors = [c[:7] for c in cmap.colors]
color = colors[4]

```

# Stats

```{python}
#| output: false

# weekdays
weekdays_wide = ['Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Wednesday', 'Thursday', 'Friday', 'Saturday', 'Sunday']
weekdays_short = {f'{d}': d[:3] for d in weekdays_wide}

# Define plots

# bar plot, by month
bar_fig = px.bar(
    transactions_by_month, 
    x='year_month', 
    y='Transaction'
)
bar_fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title=None,
    yaxis_title='Transactions',
    margin={'t':0, 'b': 0},
    barcornerradius=4
)
bar_fig.update_traces(marker_color=color)

# box plot, by weekday
box_fig = px.box(
  transactions_by_day_of_week, 
  x='day_name', 
  y='Transaction',
  category_orders={
    'day_name': weekdays_wide
  }
)
box_fig.update_xaxes(
  labelalias=weekdays_short
)
box_fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title=None,
    yaxis_title='Transactions',
    margin={'t':0, 'b':0}
)
box_fig.update_traces(marker_color=color)


# calendar heatmap, by year
cal_fig = calheatmap(
  data=items, 
  x="date", 
  y="Transaction", 
  agg="count",
  colorscale=colors,
  navigation=True, 
  nav_options={
    "x": -0.05, "xanchor": "right", 
    "y": 1, "yanchor": "top",
#    "font": dict(size=14),
    "direction": "down"
  },
  total_height=160,
#  nan_color='#919191' # looks like it doesn't work
)
cal_fig.update_layout(
  margin={'t': 0}
)

```

```{python}
#| output: false

# Hour by hour bar chart

number_of_weeks = len(items['year_week'].unique())

# transactions by day, week, and hour
transactions_by_day_week_hour = items[['day_name', 'hour', 'Transaction', 'year_week']]\
  .groupby(['day_name', 'year_week', 'hour'])\
  .nunique()\
  .reset_index()

# aggregate and calculate mean values
mean_transactions_by_day_hour = transactions_by_day_week_hour[['day_name', 'hour', 'Transaction']]\
  .groupby(['day_name', 'hour'])\
  .sum() / number_of_weeks

# pivot table
mean_transactions_by_day_hour = mean_transactions_by_day_hour\
  .reset_index()\
  .pivot(index="hour", columns="day_name", values="Transaction")\
  .fillna(0)

df = mean_transactions_by_day_hour.reset_index()
first_day = 'Monday'

# define histogram
hour_fig = px.histogram(
  df, 
  x='hour',
  y=first_day,
)

# traces
hour_fig.update_traces(
  xbins_size=1,
  marker_color=color
)

# x-axis
hour_fig.update_xaxes(
    ticktext=np.arange(0, 25),
    tickvals=np.arange(0, 25) - 0.5,
    range=[6, 22]
)

# y-axis
hour_fig.update_yaxes(
    range=[0, 14]
)

# define buttons for updatemenu
buttons = []
for day_name in weekdays_wide:
  buttons.append(
    dict(
      label=day_name[:3],
      method='update',
      args=[{
        'x': [df['hour']],
        'y': [df[day_name]]
      }]
    )
  )

# updatemenu config
menus = [
  dict(
    type='dropdown',
    buttons=buttons,
    x=0.02,
    xanchor='left',
    y=0.98,
    yanchor='top',
  )
]

# layout
hour_fig.update_layout(
  bargap=0.1,
  xaxis_title=None,
  yaxis_title=None,
  margin={'t':0, 'b':0},
  barcornerradius=4,
  updatemenus=menus,
)
```
